[i][b]The Abolishment of Non-Human Segregation Act[/b]

Since 1948, the Non-Human Segregation Act has been enforced in society, legally separating humans from non-human beings and major furry species. For nearly eight decades, this law institutionalized discrimination, denying non-humans equal rights in citizenship, education, housing, employment, and military service.
With the change of government and the rising demand for justice from both citizens and international partners, the Oceanice Republic has taken a decisive step forward. On August 21, 2025, the Abolishment of Non-Human Segregation Act was officially declared.

This legislation ends the enforced division between human and non-human communities, granting full and equal citizenship rights to all non-humans. Access to public institutions, schools, and workplaces without discrimination. The freedom to serve in the representative, armed forces, and civil service. Legal protections against hate crimes and systemic prejudice.

[u][b]President Vanklyis Herman[/b][/u]

Citizens of the Oceanice Republic 
For seventy-seven years, this nation has lived under a law that divided us. The Non-Human Segregation Act, born in 1948, set humans apart from those who share our lands, our homes, and our destiny. It declared two peoples, two paths, and it built walls that weakened us from within.

Today, we mark the end of that division. By the will of the Republic, and by my hand, the Abolishment of Non-Human Segregation Act is now law. From this day forward, no citizen shall be judged by species, but by loyalty, by service, and by the character they show in devotion to Oceanice.

Let it be clear, this is not surrender, nor shame, nor rewriting of history. It is a strength. It is the uniting of every arm and every voice that calls this land home. In recent struggles, we have seen non-human soldiers fight and bleed beside us. We have seen engineers, doctors, and teachers who prove their worth beyond doubt. The Republic must reward loyalty with citizenship, and valor with honor.
To those who resist this change, know this Oceanice will not fracture again. Our enemies beyond our borders wait eagerly for weakness. We will not give it to them. Unity is our weapon, division is their hope.

Citizens of human and non-human alike, I call upon you now. Serve together. Work together. Build together. Let the world see that the Oceanice Republic is not a nation fractured by fear, but a power made greater by its unity.

This is the path forward. This is the future. This is the destiny of Oceanice.
[/i]
